chat_proposals_shape.name: chat_proposals_shape
chat_proposals_shape.value: ("chat_proposals"."team_id" is not null and "chat_proposals"."topic_id" is not null and "chat_proposals"."topic_edit" is not null and "chat_proposals"."digest" is null) or ("chat_proposals"."team_id" is null and "chat_proposals"."digest" is not null and "chat_proposals"."topic_edit" is null)

chat_turns_chat_room_shape.name: chat_turns_chat_room_shape
chat_turns_chat_room_shape.value: ("chat_turns"."kind" = 'chat_room') = ("chat_turns"."room_message_id" is not null) and ("chat_turns"."kind" <> 'chat_room' or ("chat_turns"."question" is null and "chat_turns"."answer" is null))

chat_turns_podcast_shape.name: chat_turns_podcast_shape
chat_turns_podcast_shape.value: ("chat_turns"."kind" = 'podcast' and "chat_turns"."episode_id" is not null and "chat_turns"."chapter_position" is not null and "chat_turns"."podcast_answer_speaker" is not null and "chat_turns"."topic_id" is not null and "chat_turns"."team_id" is null) or ("chat_turns"."kind" <> 'podcast' and "chat_turns"."episode_id" is null and "chat_turns"."chapter_position" is null and "chat_turns"."podcast_answer_speaker" is null)

chat_turns_topic_post_shape.name: chat_turns_topic_post_shape
chat_turns_topic_post_shape.value: ("chat_turns"."kind"::text <> 'topic_post' and "chat_turns"."topic_post_id" is null) or ("chat_turns"."kind"::text = 'topic_post' and "chat_turns"."topic_id" is not null and "chat_turns"."team_id" is null)

chat_turns_spend_shape.name: chat_turns_spend_shape
chat_turns_spend_shape.value: "chat_turns"."kind" not in ('transcription', 'speech') or ("chat_turns"."question" is null and "chat_turns"."answer" is null and "chat_turns"."tool_calls" is null)

invites_target_xor.name: invites_target_xor
invites_target_xor.value: ("invites"."topic_id" is not null) <> ("invites"."team_id" is not null)

push_notification_sends_kind_shape.name: push_notification_sends_kind_shape
push_notification_sends_kind_shape.value: ("push_notification_sends"."kind" = 'topic-scan' and "push_notification_sends"."scan_id" is not null and "push_notification_sends"."room_message_id" is null) or ("push_notification_sends"."kind" = 'chat-mention' and "push_notification_sends"."room_message_id" is not null and "push_notification_sends"."scan_id" is null)

comments_chapter_on_podcast_episode.name: comments_chapter_on_podcast_episode
comments_chapter_on_podcast_episode.value: "comments"."chapter_position" is null or "comments"."podcast_episode_id" is not null
